deploymentEvidence.primaryConfiguration: Official BNB Chain deployment table Pool / Router = 0x19609B03C976CCA288fbDae5c21d4290e9a4aDD7; integration guideline directs ordinary own-pool swaps to this Router.
deploymentEvidence.note: No Main Pool or cross-chain pool capability target added. Current frontend BNBx side-pool configuration is supplementary lifecycle evidence, not independently verified pool implementation.

abiEvidence.note: Sourcify exact_match for root; full exact address source and original ABI preserved, not an inferred fork ABI. Direct Ownable router, no proxy delegation or upgrade method in applicable source. Explorer fetch returned 403 and is not used as an ABI source. Not persistent live bytecode attestation.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current first-party product describes its own single-sided AMM liquidity plus separate aggregator routing and exposes Pool, Boost and Gauge sections.
Current Pool app retains BNBx/WBNB side-pool configuration rather than relying solely on legacy Main Pool.
Completed Q4-2023 BUSD sunset and unchecked Q1-2024 Sunsetting main-pools plan; do not interpret as protocol-wide or router retirement. Main-pool/BUSD direct targets intentionally not admitted.

# Integration Guideline

This page provides a high-level guide on integrating with Wombat on various projects.

### Swap

You will want to use the [`Router`](/developers/integration-guideline/router.md) contract. To get a quote, use [`getAmountOut`](/developers/integration-guideline/router.md#function-getamountout). To swap BEP20 tokens, use [`swapExactTokensForTokens`](/developers/integration-guideline/router.md#function-swapexacttokensfortokens). Each swap in the path will incur a haircut fee, which can differ for each pool.

### Yield Farming

First, [`deposit`](/developers/integration-guideline/pool.md#function-deposit) your tokens to a [`Pool`](/developers/integration-guideline/pool.md) (which may trigger a deposit gain). You'll get LP tokens in BEP20 format.

Then, use [`MasterWombat`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md)'s [`getAssetPid`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-getassetpid) to find the id of the asset. Use the id to [`deposit`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-deposit) the LP tokens into MasterWombat. Alternatively, you may set the param `shouldStake` to be true while calling`Pool.deposit` (This feature is experimental. Please use it with caution).

To view a user's position, you may read the value `amount` returned by [MasterWombat.userInfo](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-userinfo).

After the deposit, you may use [`pendingTokens`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-pendingtokens) to check for any pending rewards. Note that there may be more than one reward token. To claim rewards, you can either do a [`deposit`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-deposit) (with zero amount), [`withdraw`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-withdraw) (with zero amount), or call [`multiClaim`](/developers/integration-guideline/masterwombatv2.md#function-multiclaim) to claim one or more positions.

The withdrawal flow is similar to the above in reverse.

### veWOM

You may call [VeWom.mint](/developers/integration-guideline/vewom.md#function-mint) to lock WOM into the contract and mint veWOM with a length of 7 days to 1461 days. Up to 10000 positions could be locked for each user. To view locked positions, call [VeWom.getUserInfo](/developers/integration-guideline/vewom.md#function-getuserinfo). After the locking period, call [VeWom.burn](/developers/integration-guideline/vewom.md#function-burn) to burn veWOM and get back locked WOM.

### Questions

Please use our [discord](/resources/links.md#discord) if you have any questions.

sourceSemantics.root: Direct WombatRouter with immutable wNative; fixed IPool deposit/withdraw/withdrawFromOtherAsset/swap interfaces and SafeERC20 caller funding. Full root dependencies in compiler source bundle preserved.
sourceSemantics.fundingAndOwnership: Only msg.sender input token or LP is transferFrom-funded; payable entry uses msg.value. to controls output/LP recipient but not another payer. Owner pool approvals are excluded.
sourceSemantics.unitsFeesAndLimits: Native wei; native wrapper WBNB. Token and LP units native decimals. Outer swap final minimum/deadline, pool-defined curve/fees/coverage and liquidity conversion/rounding. LP bounds passed to pool. No oracle/fee/TVL attestation.
sourceSemantics.stakingAndExit: shouldStake is finite pool-configured financial stake after mint; integration docs call it experimental. LP exit consumes caller LP and returns BNB via unwrap. No generic callback payload, new permit or signing authority.

limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Only the documented BNB Chain direct WombatRouter is admitted, not website aggregator routes, cross-chain messaging, bridge, arbitrary executor, proxy-admin, governance or deprecated MasterWombatV2. Router is non-proxy; constructor fixes WBNB 0xbb4cdb9cbd36b01bd1cbaebf2de08d9173bc095c. Pool contracts and owner-controlled router allowances remain dependencies, not independently runtime-attested here.

Caller selects pool/token route, amounts, recipient, minimums and deadline. This metadata does not constrain those financial inputs; use genuine maintained Wombat pools. Router uses fixed IPool financial selectors, never caller-supplied opaque executable bytes. It is not an aggregator executor.

Token-input swaps safeTransferFrom only msg.sender; native-input methods wrap msg.value. Native-output methods unwrap WBNB then send BNB to the chosen recipient, whose receive behavior can revert. Nonpayable methods require zero native value. Raw token and liquidity quantities use their own token decimals; BNB uses wei.

Swap route has one more token than pools; intermediate swaps use zero per-hop minimum and maximum deadline, while outer call enforces final minimum and deadline. Each pool applies its own haircut/curve/coverage/rounding; quote estimates are not execution guarantees. No fee-on-transfer support is inferred.

Native LP entry wraps msg.value and calls pool.deposit with caller-supplied minimum LP, recipient, deadline and shouldStake. shouldStake invokes the pool-configured staking path; official docs label it experimental. LP exits pull only caller LP, withdraw ordinary or cross-asset WBNB, unwrap and pay recipient; limits and deadlines are enforced by the selected pool. No staking/claim workflow is promised.

The official roadmap has a Q1-2024 unchecked plan to sunset main-pools and a completed BUSD sunset. This does not state that the router or all side/dynamic pools are retired. No direct Main Pool/BUSD target is added; the current live Pool app retains BNBx/WBNB side-pool configuration. Route availability, retired assets and pool enablement must be assessed when constructing a transaction.
